name: On the Rocks
description: On the Rocks isn't just a restaurant. It's a destination. Perched on Blouberg Strand with uninterrupted views of Table Mountain and Robben Island, we offer elegant coastal dining from sunrise breakfasts to romantic sunset dinners. A local favourite and must-visit tourist spot, known for signature dishes, Bertha Wines, and the most beautiful views in Cape Town.

items.name: The Florentine
items.description: Smoked trout, baby spinach, and poached eggs adorned with Mornay sauce and salmon roe, served on sourdough.

items.name: The Jonkershuis
items.description: Crispy pork belly meets hummus and poached egg, complemented by field mushroom and pesto.

items.name: West Coast Oysters
items.description: Fresh oysters served with pickled shallots or a fragrant touch of fennel pollen.

items.name: Tempura Prawns
items.description: Crispy prawns balanced with smoked salmon and a zingy lime dressing.

items.name: Cape Malay Seafood Curry
items.description: Kingklip and prawns in a fragrant curry, accompanied by jasmine rice, tomato sambal, and raita.

items.name: Seafood Paella
items.description: A medley of prawns, mussels, calamari, and the rich zest of chorizo.

items.name: Dry Aged Beef Fillet
items.description: Enhanced with tarragon butter, served with seasonal trimmings.

items.name: Herb & Mint Crusted Rack of Lamb
items.description: Beautifully complemented by fondant potato and charred baby marrow.

items.name: Cape Velvet Panna Cotta
items.description: Poached plums, almond soil, and an On the Rocks twist.

items.name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
items.description: Decadently served with salted caramel popcorn and crème fraîche.

testimonials.text: The view alone is worth the trip. Best restaurant view in Cape Town.
testimonials.author: WhaleTales Blog

testimonials.text: A must-visit for postcard finders, tourists, and locals alike.
testimonials.author: Cape Town Foodie
